obernants.assumptions: Real annotator/morph loading, corpus filesystem parsing, full training/evaluation and teacher paths remain unexecuted. Residual exactness is diagnostic reconstruction, not semantic understanding.
obernants.domain: Small synthetic tokens, initialized tables, finite nonnegative weights, valid coordinates; Rule Drop acyclic; LCS <=65535 and counts/arithmetic representable.
obernants.observation_scope: Hebrew Reader train owns meta tokens through IBM then Strong override; owners feed HebEncoder train. meta MTok ctx_keys feed profile and HebEncoder; Fw/Rule remap their heads. Logic consumes event concepts via Lexicon and LCS. Strong is optional alignment input, not a translation oracle.
obernants.operator: Valid head-remapping transforms do not retain deleted coordinates; exact residual gates do not entail exact normal translation. Logical-word equality does not imply equal propositions.

Event comparison is separate: permutations preserve verb-multiset gaps, while LCS pairing (including repeated-verb ties) can change contradictions and distance.
